description: Agent-based network simulation of mask adoption and compliance under peer influence, observed norms, policy enforcement, media messaging, and supply constraints.

parameters.income_distribution: lognormal(mean=10.5, sigma=0.6) in annual USD thousands
parameters.perceived_mask_cost_init: equal to module SupplyAndPurchaseModule consumer price of chosen mask type

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the social contact network with small-world structure and homophily on political identity and education.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t==0:
  create_network = WattsStrogatz(N=population_size, k=average_degree, p=small_world_rewiring_prob)
  apply_homophily: rewire a fraction homophily_strength of edges to match on political_identity and education_level
  output signal.social_network
notes: Homophily implemented by edge swap heuristic preserving degree distribution.

modules.name: EpidemicSignalModule
modules.description: Generates and updates epidemic prevalence signal and maps it to personal risk perception.

notes: Personal outbreaks increment experienced_outbreak_personal via exogenous flag updates.

modules.name: MediaBroadcastModule
modules.description: Broadcasts media messages, computes individual exposure and updates attitudes via trust-weighted influence.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each outlet:
  if Bernoulli(outlet.message_frequency * media_message_frequency) == 1:
    message_bias = outlet.bias + Normal(0,0.05)
    is_misinformation = Bernoulli(outlet.misinformation_rate)
    deliver to audience sampled by outlet.reach and media_targeting_strength matching target_demographics_tag
for each person:
  pro = sum(messages with positive bias received) * person.trust_in_media * media_trust_weight
  anti = sum(messages with negative bias or misinformation) * (1 - person.trust_in_media) * media_trust_weight
  person.exposure_to_pro_mask_messages = (1 - 0.3) * prev + pro
  person.exposure_to_misinformation = (1 - 0.3) * prev + anti
  person.mask_attitude += clamp(pro - anti + media_bias_mean, -0.2, 0.2)
  clamp person.mask_attitude to [0,1]
notes: Bias mean shifts net message tone.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcementModule
modules.description: Activates mandates, communicates guidance, sets enforcement and applies penalties/non-entry.

notes: Penalties contribute to perceived_mask_cost via expectation of fines.
Message tone prosocial increases attitudes; authoritarian tone reduces reactance in high trust but may increase reactance in low trust.

modules.name: MobilityAndLocationModule
modules.description: Generates daily schedules, moves persons between locations, sets crowding and signage signals, and records observed norms by location.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person:
  generate daily_schedule per schedule_model with probabilities workplace_visit_prob, retail_visit_prob, leisure_visit_prob, transit_use_prob
  visit sequence: home -> (workplace?) -> (transit?) -> (retail/leisure?) -> home
for each location:
  set crowding_level = clamp(location_crowding_base * stochastic_factor, 0, 1)
  signage_effect = signage_effect_weight * location.signage_visible
compute observed mask-wearing rate by location type from previous day to form signal.location_norms
notes: Crowding influences immediate compliance in AdoptionDecision via crowding_effect_on_compliance_weight.

modules.name: SupplyAndPurchaseModule
modules.description: Updates stock and prices; persons purchase masks given budget, preferences, and availability; tracks shortages.

update_rule.pseudocode:
apply_shortage = Bernoulli(shortage_shock_probability)
restock = max(0, Normal(restock_rate_daily, restock_rate_daily * supply_restock_variance))
if apply_shortage: restock *= 0.2
available_mask_stock += restock
update prices by price_elasticity * (demand_yesterday - restock)/max(restock,1)
for each person at start of day or upon denied entry:
  if mask_inventory < 1 and intends_to_wear:
    budget = income * purchase_budget_share
    choose type using preferences: high_risk_to_N95_preference, low_income_to_cloth_preference
    if stock sufficient and price <= budget: purchase up to max_masks_per_purchase, decrement stock
    else: record shortage_incident
update perceived_mask_cost = current price of chosen type + expected penalty if policy active
output stock_prices and shortage incidents
notes: Demand_yesterday approximated by total purchases yesterday.
Price elasticity negative reduces price when stock accumulates.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Updates mask attitudes via peer influence on the social network with thresholds and reactance.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person:
  neighbor_attitudes = mean(mask_attitude of neighbors weighted by tie_weight_scale)
  threshold = Normal(threshold_distribution_mean, threshold_distribution_std)
  delta = peer_influence_weight * (neighbor_attitudes - person.mask_attitude)
  reactance = reactance_weight * person.reactance_tendency * sign(-delta) if policy_active else 0
  person.mask_attitude = clamp(person.mask_attitude + delta + reactance, 0, 1)
output peer_attitudes per person
notes: Reactance pushes attitudes away when feeling coerced.
Thresholds can be used to gate influence; here implemented as noise around sensitivity.

modules.name: NormObservationModule
modules.description: Forms perceived norms from observed mask-wearing by location and updates short-term compliance tendency.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person:
  observed_norm = weighted average of location norms visited yesterday
  person.compliance_propensity = clamp((1 - norm_memory_decay) * person.compliance_propensity + observed_norms_influence_weight * observed_norm + norm_sensitivity_to_signage * signage_effect, 0, 1)
output norm_pressure = compliance_propensity vector
notes: Signage effect comes from MobilityAndLocationModule's signage_effect_weight and location signage.

modules.name: AdoptionDecisionModule
modules.description: Combines risk, policy, norms, media, habits, fatigue, and costs to decide mask use and type.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person:
  utility_benefit = personal_risk_weight * person.risk_perception * mask_effectiveness_weight + policy_influence_weight * I(policy_active) * (person.trust_in_authorities) + trust_weight * person.trust_in_media * (person.exposure_to_pro_mask_messages - person.exposure_to_misinformation) + peer_influence_weight * (mean_neighbor_attitudes - 0.5)
  disutility = disutility_cost_scale * (person.perceived_mask_cost) + fatigue_growth_rate * person.fatigue_level + reactance_weight * person.reactance_tendency * I(policy_active)
  habit = habit_formation_rate * person.habit_strength
  norm_push = signal.norm_pressure[person]
  latent_score = utility_benefit + norm_push + habit - disutility + baseline_compliance_noise_scale * Gumbel(0,1)
  p_wear = sigmoid(latent_score)
  wear_today = Bernoulli(p_wear)
  if wear_today:
    choose mask_type: argmax expected effectiveness per price given preferences and risk (N95 favored if risk high)
    decrement inventory; if inventory low, trigger purchase intent
    person.mask_adoption_state = 'wearing'; person.habit_strength = clamp(person.habit_strength + habit_formation_rate, 0,1); person.fatigue_level = max(person.fatigue_level - fatigue_recovery_rate, 0)
  else:
    person.mask_adoption_state = 'none'; person.habit_strength = max(person.habit_strength - forgetting_rate, 0); person.fatigue_level = min(person.fatigue_level + fatigue_growth_rate, 1)
collect mask_type_mix distribution
output adoption_state boolean vector and mask_type_mix
notes: Perceived cost includes expected penalty if non-compliant where enforcement applies.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates adoption signals and computes observables and KPIs.

update_rule.pseudocode:
overall = mean(adoption_state)
by_loc = for each location type: mean(adoption among visitors to that type today)
if overall >= target_adoption_rate and not recorded: record day as time_to_target
mask_dist = mask_type_mix
if policy_active: compliance = mean(adoption_state among those under mandate)
compute DiD: (mean(overall in post window) - mean(overall in pre window)) - (counterfactual trend estimate)
compute income inequality: Gini of adoption probability by income quintile
media_exposure_dist = histogram(pro vs anti exposures)
shortages = count of shortage incidents today (accumulate over time)
penalties = sum penalties_today (accumulate total and count)
output all observables
notes: Counterfactual trend via linear trend from pre-window days.
Gini computed on group means weighted by group size.

algorithms.WattsStrogatzHomophily: Small-world network generator with post-hoc homophily edge swaps.
algorithms.DeGrootInfluenceWithReactance: Weighted averaging of neighbor attitudes with reactance term when policy active.
algorithms.NormativeComplianceUpdate: Exponential smoothing of perceived norms influencing compliance propensity.
algorithms.UtilityBasedAdoption: Logit choice combining risk, norms, media, policy, habit, fatigue, and cost.
algorithms.SupplyDemandPricing: Price updates proportional to demand-stock imbalance with negative elasticity.
algorithms.DifferenceInDifferences: Pre/post mandate comparison adjusted by pre-period trend for policy effect.
